propositions: Known key must be persisted on the still-pending binding entry via record_pending_key before the canonical label is attached to survive create-to-label window crashes.
Any failure after Jira returns a key must preserve the remote issue (never delete), the keyed-pending recovery evidence, and the known key with exact typed disposition.
The canonical label must be attached before optional property enrichment, and confirmation (bind_confirm) must occur only after both label and property attempts.
Property unsupported/permission failures must remain visible and cannot erase a successful label or trigger rollback.
All binding persistence must occur exclusively through the RP-02 BindingStore facade; no secondary binding writer.
Post-create lifecycle intents execute only after their remote postconditions are verified.
